profile.headline: Front-End Engineering
profile.summary: I fight for the users. Curious, communicative technologist with 14+ years of software and design experience -- four years as a generalist with a SaaS product team; four years as a design agency web mercenary building everything from marketing widgets to multi-page Wordpress homepages to SCORM modules; now 6+ years building and maintaining various platform-level essentials like global navigation, microfrontend architecture, and monorepo tooling for web apps at Indeed to help people get jobs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build and maintain functional, accessible web interfaces using TypeScript and React backed by federated GraphQL datastore via Apollo
- Plan, manage, implement major library upgrades like React and component library versions across customers of internal microfrontend platform
- Embracing third generation LLM development tooling including Cursor, Copilot, and especially Claude Code

positions.title: UX Developer
positions.description:
- Build and maintain functional, accessible web interfaces using TypeScript and React backed by federated GraphQL datastore via Apollo
- UX Developer role sits in UX organization but embeds within product engineering teams to write code and act as a bridge between design and development personnel. Extensive collaboration with peers from design, product, engineering, and quality assurance teams.
- Accessibility focus: tested for and remediated issues in web forms and pages especially around keyboard navigation and screen reader support. Became certified as IAAP Web Accessibility Specialist: participated in an internal training program Spring 2024 to prepare for the exam.
- QA/test tech: wrote and maintained Jest unit testing and Cypress end-to-end (e2e) testing including targeted efforts to improve testing reliability and coverage
- Design system: extensive use of internal CSS-in-JS design component system built on Theme UI and Emotion libraries with extensive API. Contributed and maintained a component molecule to internal pattern library built from design system component atoms. Drove efforts to uplift and retrofit less-maintained projects to newer library versions and standards

positions.title: Senior Interactive Developer
positions.description: Developed pixel-perfect, responsive websites with hand-crafted HTML/CSS/JavaScript from Adobe Illustrator files generated by design team. Met directly with clients to determine their project goals, needs, and technical specifications. Concepted, ideated, and presented solutions with project manager, content writer/editor, and graphic designer(s).

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Pulse Analytics & Pulse Athletics product team - a social media monitoring tool focused on sentiment analysis to promote customer engagement including correlating public opinion to advertising efforts
Internal operations and support for sales and development teams – set up demos, wrote bug reports and feature requests, tested new code, wrote customer-facing documentation
Provided customer support for prospective and paying customers via phone, email and screen sharing softwares

Intern summer 2012 to fall 2012 through UW HuskyJobs, hired long-term following internship.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
Repaired and refurbished consumer electronics
Helped customers over the phone to troubleshoot technical problems with their purchases and worked with customer service staff to facilitate returns when necessary

positions.title: Geek Squad Agent, Computer Sales
positions.description:
Solved client issues with computers, computing accessories, mobile devices
Sold and performed services based on client need (malware, diagnostics, data services)
Developed product and service solutions for customers buying new technology

positions.title: Administrative Intern
positions.description:
Converted internal website from HTML to wiki for ease of access and modification.
Filed documents, signed for deliveries, miscellaneous tasks for office administrator.
